notes.title: Android update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Just pushed the last update, which now is fully compatible with Android. So now you can connect between the two platforms.

Also fixed some bugs, like macro editing and help screens.

Hope you enjoy Handy Dice and have fun!

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nuclear.handydice]Handy Dice on Play Store[/url]

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Just released a new update with some multiplayer improvements (One dice mode, clients now can erase dice, and some more).
Improved interface, now dice assigning is much better, and texture selector for dice creating is reworked.
Also dice are now stored in a single file, making it much easier uploading to workshop.

Soon will update the android version so will be compatible with pc, you will be able to connect between platforms and share dice!

As always, please report any bug or suggestion you may have, enjoy!

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28508214/6f89c5b8dd8947a9894dd6e514a8daa9445355e2.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28508214/72bdc9a934b82bcd44b0e087af06ae5ea910b7c7.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Multiplayer and more!
notes.notes:
Just added multiplayer support, now you can share your table with your friends. Online features are still under development, so not everything that should is included but main features are.

At the moment the dice set used is the server's one.

Also some improvements has been done:
[list]
[*]Better dice shaders.
[*]The base of a message system (soon there will be a chat).
[*]A file size check is added.
[*]Improved a bit the workshop uploading tool.
[*]Some performance improvements.
[/list]

Old dice still works on single player mode, but if their size is bigger than 64kb, will cause errors, so please, update them.

Remember you can report bugs or share your suggestions on comunity forums, will gladly consider them.

Have fun!

notes.title: A quick update
notes.notes:
Fixed some bugs:
[list]
    [*]Misbehaviour when not entering a valid name on dice creation.
    [*]Now when a die is created the cfg file is fine.
    [*]When pressing the cancel button on file browser, the interface no longer is blocked.
    [*]Now side menus can be closed left clicking outside them.
[/list]

Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Handy Dice is available on Early access!
notes.notes:
Handy Dice is just released so now you can buy it, hope you like it.
